name: devorch-cli
description: The devorch Claude Code plugin, published with every devorch CLI release. Install or update it with 'devorch plugin install'.

plugins.name: devorch
plugins.description: The DevOrch skills (/devorch:sdlc-drive, /devorch:step), the devorch:step-worker agent and a DevOrch MCP server, plus the companion mod that wakes an idle step session when a watched run can move, shows run position and open blockers, and answers blockers from a slash command.
